# `organization`

Core object · HSDS v3.2.3 · tabular file `organizations.csv` · [online reference](https://docs.openreferral.org/en/latest/hsds/schema_reference.html#organization)

> The details about each organization delivering services. Each service should be linked to the organization responsible for its delivery. One organization may deliver many services.

**Required:** `id`, `name`, `description`

Scalar fields are the columns of the tabular (CSV) form. Nested fields exist only in the JSON form, where the related objects are embedded (dereferenced).
